sourceRefs.locator: Table 1 and pp. 614–615, Figs. 6–7: architectural phases of the Western Deffufa and its religious quarter.
Description, paragraphs on the capital of Kush and goods, pottery and seal impressions connected with exchange.

summary.de: Großer Lehmziegelbau mit mehreren Umbauphasen. Er bildete das Zentrum eines religiösen Viertels in Kerma.
summary.en: Large mudbrick building with successive rebuilding phases. It stood at the centre of Kerma’s religious quarter.
